div.div: صَلَعَةٌ A place of baldness such as is termed صَلَعٌ; (S, O, Msb, K;) as also ↓ صُلْعَةٌ ; (S, O, K;) and ↓ صَلْعَةٌ is said to be a contraction of the first, (O, Msb,) by Lth, (O,) but it is disallowed by the thoroughly learned. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
